objective: 8000+ distinct rights-cleared lineage-safe FIT source identities PER head, NOT 8000 per source pool
scope: external source discovery, remote pinned metadata intake and head-target extractability prior to 10K master expansion

status_meanings.PUBLISHED_NATIVE: Published dataset has some directly useful native evidence for this head. Still needs independent source/court/rights; not ready to train.
status_meanings.SOURCE_RECOVERY: Published processed form omits head-critical fields; must recover original 3D source or a separately source-provenanced equivalent before any truth builder.
status_meanings.SOURCE_AND_BUILDER: Original or published geometry supports candidate derivation, but a new verified teacher builder and review are mandatory.
status_meanings.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Possible source evidence exists; suitability, original license or authority not verified.
status_meanings.NO_EVIDENCE: No grounded route from released data alone; requires another source or independent generation with reviewed original evidence.
